moneyline_rule: For every game, record the team with the higher V10 home_model/away_model probability.
total_rule: For every game with a total line, record the higher over_model/under_model side. total_actual_hit_prob equals the selected conditional side probability multiplied by (1 - push_prob).
top10_rule: Exactly matches current SPORTS LAB recommendation policy: choose the available market with the highest unmodified candidate_hit_prob for each game, break ties by EV, then rank the best one-per-game candidates by hit probability and keep the top 10. No probability/edge/EV minimum gate.
settlement_rule: Moneyline: predicted winner versus final winner. Total: compare final combined runs with frozen total_line; equality to an integer line is PUSH. Postponed/suspended/non-final games remain PENDING. Hit rate excludes PUSH and PENDING from the denominator and reports them separately.
